cards.text: Jesus just rebuked the winds and the sea, and it was perfectly calm (Matthew 8:26). Now He lands on the other side, in the region of the Gadarenes. And somebody meets Him there, friend, and it is NOT a welcome committee.

cards.question: Jesus lands in the region of the Gadarenes. Who comes to meet Him?
Where are these two demon-possessed men coming from?
The two demon-possessed men from the tombs are so ___ that no one can pass that way.

cards.text: Then the two men start SHOUTING at Jesus. He JUST got off the boat, friend. Not even a "hello, how was the trip?"

cards.question: True or false: The two men shouting at Jesus know who He is.

cards.text: They shout, "What do You want with us, Son of God?" I think these two already know this meeting is NOT going their way.

cards.question: The two men shout another question at Jesus. What do they ask if He has come here to do?

answers.text: Torture them before the appointed time
Send them back across the sea
Bring the whole town against them

cards.text: Hold on. Back on the boat, the men just asked, "What kind of man is this?" (Matthew 8:27). And these two men are out here SHOUTING the answer: Son of God.
Meanwhile, in the distance, a large herd of pigs is feeding. Just chewing. Living their best life. They have NO idea they're about to end up in the Bible.

cards.question: The demons beg Jesus for something if He drives them out. What do they ask?

answers.text: Let them stay in the tombs
Send them out into the desert

cards.question: True or false: Jesus answers the demons' request with a long speech.

cards.text: "Go!" He tells them, and they come out and go into the pigs. ONE word and they're GONE. Friend, I once spent a whole afternoon asking a fly to leave my bakery. The fly won.
The whole herd takes off running, and that sea Jesus just crossed is right there. Pigs that were chewing peacefully a second ago are now moving like somebody yelled FREE COOKIES.

cards.question: Once the demons go into the pigs, where does the whole herd rush?

answers.text: Down the steep bank into the sea
Off the road and into the town
Back across the hills to the tombs

cards.text: The whole herd dies in the waters. And now the guys tending those pigs have to go explain it, and I promise you that report starts with, "So... you're gonna want to sit down."

cards.question: Those tending the pigs run off into the town. What do they report?

answers.text: Everything including what happened to the two men
Only that the whole herd was lost
That thieves had taken the herd away

cards.text: Then the WHOLE town goes out to meet Jesus. I haven't seen a crowd move that fast since the Millers' oven timer went off and the whole family came running for the first cookie.

cards.question: When the whole town sees Jesus, they beg Him to ___ their region.

findings.problem: This non-opening story card has three sentences: the men shout, Jesus has just arrived, and the greeting punchline. Story cards after the opening are limited to two sentences.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: This card revisits Matthew 8:27 and the Son of God statement already given on card 7. It adds a reflection on that connection but does not advance through the passage, making it a recap card.

rule.text: Every story card moves the baker forward through the passage. No recap cards.

findings.problem: This story card has four punctuated sentences or sentence fragments: the pigs are feeding, "Just chewing," "Living their best life," and the Bible punchline. The limit is two.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: This story card has four sentences: the demons come out, the one-word reaction, the bakery setup, and "The fly won." It needs to be shortened to two sentences without losing the moment or the joke.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: The phrase "a second ago" adds an elapsed time between the pigs feeding and rushing away. Matthew gives no such time interval.

rule.text: Times stay true. No time in the text means none added.

findings.problem: The oven-timer episode at the Millers' home invents a new incident in Papa Dorin's established backstory. The permission for invented small moments applies around his bakery, not to adding new Miller-family memories.

rule.text: His backstory, family, bakery and mission are the Dorinverse story in this file. He can talk about them freely, but never adds anything new to them. His jokes can make up small moments and habits around his bakery.
